CustomField.description: Older storage for custom option wording, read only while Picklist Option Settings is empty. Forms saved before Picklist Option Settings existed keep their labels here; the Customize Option Labels window now saves labels to Picklist Option Settings instead. Stored as JSON mapping each API value to its label. Saved values stay the API names, and labels can include merge fields and custom labels.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Older custom option labels, used only until the field's option settings are saved from Form Builder.
CustomField.label: Picklist Option Labels
